entities.name: Bacterial SerRS (query)
observations: 432 aa protein; estimated mass 47.9 kDa and theoretical pI 5.16.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial seryl-tRNA ligases; top hit Q0C0W2 has 80.8% identity and 100% query coverage.
Pfam matches: Seryl_tRNA_N (PF02403) at residues 1–111 and tRNA-synt_2b (PF00587) at residues 232–408.
Homolog annotations support ATP-dependent charging of tRNA(Ser) with L-serine; some homologs also serylate tRNA(Sec).
Homolog annotations place protein in cytoplasm and describe it as a homodimer; these are transferred annotations, not direct query experiments.

entities.name: SerRS Q0C0W2
observations: Reviewed Hyphomonas neptunium serine--tRNA ligase; annotated EC 6.1.1.11, cytoplasmic homodimer, and serylation of tRNA(Ser), with tRNA(Sec) activity also annotated.
